# The compiler accepts avow declarations with optional filler words and warns on the old phrase keyword
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #199, sha256:618831c8008f536be9faa04f6d43c945ccbd4503bf82c53432f3c4391a5f0caa). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Ready
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** compiler (M; Avowry rename, language step 1)
- **Milestone:** Purpose: verifiability, preserved intent and reviewability
- **Source:** The product owner's decision that the in-language unit is an avow, and Decider D126 (2026-10-29).
- **Depends on:** 191
- **Story:** As Dana, I want to declare a unit as avow to "validate task title {title: Text}" and have the old phrase keyword keep working with a warning, so that the language reads as a promise without breaking what I wrote.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given a declaration avow, then at most one filler from the fixed set to, that, it, then the quoted template, When it is built, Then it declares the same unit as the old phrase form, the filler is never part of the name (avow to "to do list" is named to do list), and a second filler or an unknown word before the quote is an error that names the allowed set and shows the canonical form avow to
  2. Given the old phrase keyword, When a source uses it, Then it still builds and prints warning PH212 (deprecated until 1.0), through a new severity field on diagnostics that the CLI and the has-errors checks respect, with its own tests and the generated C# unchanged
  3. Given fixtures for each filler, the missing filler, both keywords in one module and the error cases, When the gate runs, Then all pass and each new test fails when its behaviour is removed (shown by a mutation)

## Context

- Decided by D126: the template stays quoted (the parser change is one line and the arrow stays unambiguous next to generic types); fillers sit outside the quotes so they cannot collide with names; calls are unchanged; fillers are allowed only after avow. Compiler and model identifiers (PhraseCall, the source map kind phrase) are renamed on cards 194 and 195, not here. The frozen docs change in the card 162 re-freeze. Follow docs/CODING_GUIDELINES.md; stay green at every step; keep the change small enough to revert alone; nothing is published.
